description: AI-native, GPU-accelerated terminal emulator with SSH, persistent sessions, split panes, and first-class AI CLI workflows
notes: Pebrel is the renamed Nebula terminal; its data directory moved from %APPDATA%\Nebula to %APPDATA%\Pebrel
Scoop owns the profile: PEBREL_CONFIG_DIR points at the persist directory, holding settings, command history, sessions, SSH profiles, imported fonts, providers, backups and logs
On first install an existing %APPDATA%\Nebula directory is copied into the persist directory; Pebrel renames the legacy nebula.* files on first launch
Keep the ZIP layout intact; runtime\conpty.dll, runtime\OpenConsole.exe and runtime\pebrel-hook.exe are required
Saved SSH passwords live in Windows Credential Manager, not in the profile directory, and are intentionally not managed by this package
Pebrel may register its own hooks in Claude Code, Codex, opencode and Pi configuration files; those external configs stay user-owned
Close Pebrel before installing, updating or uninstalling this package
pre_install: if ($running.Count -gt 0) { throw 'Pebrel is running. Close it before installing or upgrading this package.' }
post_install: Write-Host "Seeding the Pebrel profile from the previous Nebula data directory: $legacy"
Write-Host "Seeding failed with robocopy exit code $LASTEXITCODE. The previous data was left untouched; copy it into $target manually to keep it."

script: if ($running.Count -gt 0) { throw 'Pebrel is running. Close it before uninstalling this package.' }
Write-Warning "Pebrel AI integration cleanup exited with code $LASTEXITCODE. Remove leftover Claude Code / Codex / opencode / Pi hook entries manually if needed."
